observations: Photo 0: A vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden cabinet/table; metal body with handwheel and two large knobs; foot pedal and lower storage/compartment visible.
Photo 1: Front view of the sewing machine; multiple control knobs and a needle area; machine has visible wear/scratches and some paint fading.
Photo 2: Side view showing the machine mounted on the table; power/controls area and the cabinet edge; more visible scuffs on the metal body.
Photo 3: Side view with the handwheel and belt/pulley area; machine head appears intact but has surface rust/paint wear; lower metal footrest grid present.
